headline: Blinkit Tops Quick Commerce Market in Product Availability: Bernstein
summary: Bernstein says Blinkit has an in-stock rate of 94.4% in quick commerce, ahead of its competitors. The ranking is based on product availability.
why: Blinkit is the quick-commerce grocery delivery business owned by Eternal, a major Indian consumer internet company. Availability is a key competitive factor in fast delivery.
